text:
7. For qualifying offences, PACE allows chief constables to apply for extensions to the given
retention periods for DNA profiles and fingerprints if considered necessary for prevention or
detection of crime.

8. Section 20 of the Protection of Freedoms Act 2012 established the independent office of
Commissioner for the Retention and Use of Biometric Material (‘the ‘Biometrics
Commissioner’). For details, see https://www.gov.uk/government/organisations/biometrics -
